title: Gloria (Palestrina, Missa Veni sponsa Christi)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Missa Veni sponsa Christi, Gloria, 1599. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
